title: Nine Beads on the Wrist
subtitle: 魅力与吸引力 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 魅力与吸引力（做人与做事·性格与魅力）
meta: 主题语境：魅力与吸引力（做人与做事·性格与魅力）　|　核心词汇：charm　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 charm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my mother was sent to describe ① charm she could not explain, and she said the describing was the whole of the lesson. The ② charm, meaning the trinket and not the quality, was nine beads long and was described by whoever came last; charm, she said, is the only thing on a wrist that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ charm on that wrist had the same clasp, and the ④ charm at the end, meaning the one the maker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described properly. Charm, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ charm was the whole of the visit, meaning the appeal it carried and not the trinket. The ⑥ charm, meaning the appeal and not any of that, is the only thing in a visit that everybody feels and nobody questions; charm, he said, is either something you describe or the only word that means both a trinket and an appeal. She said the appeal is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ charm had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the clasp. The ⑧ charm of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine beads and eleven years of describing; charm, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ charm I remember is the one at the end, which was described in 1975 and is still described as the plainest in the county. A ⑩ charm, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being described; every charm, she said, is an appeal that has agreed to look like a trinket. She said the appeal was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小挂件；护身符
B. n. 挂件（指那件小饰物本身，与那份气质相对）
C. 固定搭配：describe a charm 描述一件挂件
D. n. 挂件（指手腕上每一件）
E. n. 挂件（指末尾那一件）
F. n. 魅力（抽象：它承载的那份吸引力）
G. n. 那份吸引力（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The charm, meaning the trinket and not the quality

answers.why: describe a charm 意为“描述一件挂件”，1955 年母亲被派去描述她解释不清的那件挂件。
charm 意为“小挂件、护身符”，指那件小饰物本身而不是那份气质，共九颗珠子，由最后来的人描述。
charm 指手腕上每一件挂件，每一件都是同样的扣环。
charm 指末尾那一件（匠人保留的那一件），是唯一有人认真描述过的。
charm 意为“魅力”，抽象指它承载的那份吸引力，父亲说 charm 就是那次拜访的全部。
charm 为抽象用法，指那份吸引力本身，是一次拜访里人人都感受到、却没人质疑的东西。
charm 意为“小挂件、护身符”，到 1970 年这件 charm 成了报告里的一个数字。
charm 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九颗珠子和十一年的描述。
charm 意为“挂件”，我记得的是末尾那一件，1975 年被描述，至今仍被说成全县最朴素的。
charm 为抽象总称，祖母说一件挂件是唯一会因为被认真描述而变好的东西。
